rationale: This 2000 record by William E. Doolittle (American Anthropologist, DOI: 10.1525/aa.2000.102.1.201) is a book review of Susan H. Lees's 1998 book (The Political Ecology of the Water Crisis in Israel, University Press of America, 188 pp.), as shown by the abstract consisting solely of the reviewed book's publication header. As a secondary book review/commentary rather than primary empirical research or a systematic synthesis, it clearly fails Criterion 3 (E05 no empirical evidence / book review study type).
plain_vs_narrow_note: No difference between the narrow rule-type reading and the literal/plain reading of Criterion 2: both result in exclusion because the record is a published book review rather than an empirical study or systematic review.

evidence_quotes.quote: The Political Ecology of the Water Crisis in Israel. Susan H. Lees. Lanham, MD: University Press of America, 1998. 188 pp.
